headline: Israeli Cybersecurity Startups Face Market Shift Amid Mega-Mergers
summary: Consolidation between global security leaders like CrowdStrike and Zscaler is challenging independent Israeli cybersecurity startups while increasing acquisition demand for niche technologies.
why: Israel is a global hub for technological security venture creation, and international enterprise M&A trends directly govern local tech deal flows.

impacts.name: Cybersecurity Sector
impacts.why: Industry consolidation creates competitive barriers for startups while increasing acquisition opportunities.
